description: Provides bounded, approval-gated operations over trusted file selections and user destination roles.

capabilities.description: Read metadata for a bounded, server-owned selection of files or directories.

results_from.description: Server-owned reference to a trusted selection or an earlier operation result.

user_intent.description: Show trusted metadata for previously identified files or directories without reading or changing their contents.
examples: покажи информацию о найденных файлах
покажи размер и сведения о найденном файле
какой размер у этого файла
show details for the selected files
when was this folder modified

capabilities.description: Create one named child directory inside an allowed user destination after approval.

destination.description: Explicit user destination role or a trusted previously confirmed destination.

directory_name.description: One user-supplied child directory name, never an absolute path or a path containing separators.

user_intent.description: Create exactly one named folder in Desktop, Documents, Downloads, or a trusted prior destination. Never accept a raw filesystem path.
examples: создай папку Проекты на рабочем столе
сделай в документах папку Архив
create a folder called Private on my desktop
make a Receipts folder in Documents

capabilities.description: Move a bounded, server-owned selection into an allowed user destination after approval.

results_from.description: Server-owned reference to trusted search results or an earlier operation result.

destination.description: Explicit user destination role or a trusted previously confirmed destination.

directory_name.description: Optional single child directory name inside the destination, never a path.

conflict_policy.description: Fail safely on a name conflict unless the user explicitly requests creation of a non-conflicting name.

user_intent.description: Move previously found files to a bounded user destination. The selection is server-owned; destination, optional folder name, and conflict behavior remain explicit.
examples: перемести найденные файлы на рабочий стол
перенеси эти PDF в папку Учёба в документах
move the selected files to Downloads
move these documents into a Work folder on my desktop

capabilities.description: Rename exactly one item from a trusted selection after approval.

results_from.description: Server-owned reference that must resolve to exactly one file or directory.

new_name.description: One user-supplied file or directory name, never a path or path traversal.

conflict_policy.description: Fail safely on a conflict unless the user explicitly requests a non-conflicting name.

user_intent.description: Rename one previously identified file or directory. The trusted selection must contain exactly one item and new_name must be a plain name, not a path.
examples: переименуй найденный файл в отчёт.pdf
назови эту папку Архив
rename the selected file to report.pdf
rename this folder to Archive

capabilities.description: Move a bounded, server-owned selection to the desktop trash after approval.

results_from.description: Server-owned reference to trusted files or directories selected for recoverable deletion.

user_intent.description: Send previously identified files or directories to the recoverable desktop trash. Permanent deletion is not supported.
examples: перемести найденные файлы в корзину
отправь найденный файл в корзину
удали эту папку в корзину
move the selected files to trash
send this folder to the recycle bin
